name: sol-neptune-graph
description: Authenticated Gremlin access to Sol's private Amazon Neptune graph.

interface.shortDescription: Search Sol's graph with automatic neighborhood context.
interface.longDescription: Use complete typed neighborhood search in compact format by default, with explicit GraphSON compatibility, a fresh server clock, guarded semantic persistence and separately constrained Gremlin tools. Unknown mutation outcomes must never be retried blindly.
defaultPrompt: Count the vertices in Sol's private Neptune graph.
Run a bounded Gremlin query against Sol's graph.
Explain the result of a bounded graph traversal.
